book.title: Frankenstein · Chapter 2 — The Seed of an Obsession
book.author: Mary Shelley, Frankenstein (1818), Chapter 2

cast.name: Victor
cast.canonical: a studious teenage boy with untidy dark hair, round glasses and intense eyes
cast.anchor: a teenage boy with round glasses and intense studious eyes

cast.name: Elizabeth
cast.canonical: a gentle fair teenage girl with a long braid, serene and poetic
cast.anchor: a fair girl with a long braid

cast.name: Clerval
cast.canonical: a lively teenage boy in a small black top hat, waving a wooden toy sword, bright and adventurous
cast.anchor: a small top hat and a wooden toy sword

cast.name: Alphonse
cast.canonical: a tall slender dignified gentleman with a neat trimmed grey beard, no glasses, in a long dark coat
cast.anchor: a neat grey beard and a long dark coat (dignified, slender)

panels.scene: two teenagers on an Alpine terrace: a fair braided girl gazing dreamily at the mountains, a bespectacled boy peering intently at a flower he is dissecting

teen.narration: VICTOR AND ELIZABETH GROW UP INSEPARABLE — YET OPPOSITE. SHE LOVES THE BEAUTY OF THINGS; HE BURNS TO KNOW THEIR CAUSES.

bubbles.text: While my companion contemplated with a serious and satisfied spirit the magnificent appearances of things, I delighted in investigating their causes.

panels.scene: the fair braided girl reading poetry beneath towering Swiss peaks, lost in wonder

teen.narration: ELIZABETH FOLLOWS THE POETS AND THE GLORY OF THE MOUNTAINS.

bubbles.text: She busied herself with following the aerial creations of the poets
in the majestic and wondrous scenes which surrounded our Swiss home

panels.scene: the bespectacled boy hunched over books and specimens by candlelight, hungry-eyed

teen.narration: BUT VICTOR WANTS TO UNLOCK EVERYTHING — THE HIDDEN LAWS OF NATURE.

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: The world was to me a secret which I desired to divine.
Curiosity, earnest research to learn the hidden laws of nature, gladness akin to rapture, as they were unfolded to me, are among the earliest sensations I can remember.

panels.scene: a spirited teenage boy in a small top hat brandishing a wooden sword, striking a heroic knightly pose

teen.narration: THEIR DEAREST FRIEND CLERVAL LIVES FOR ADVENTURE AND ROMANCE.

bubbles.text: He loved enterprise, hardship, and even danger for its own sake. He was deeply read in books of chivalry and romance.
He composed heroic songs and began to write many a tale of enchantment and knightly adventure.

panels.scene: three costumed children acting out a play of King Arthur's knights in a garden, wooden swords and paper crowns

teen.narration: HE MAKES THEM ACT OUT HEROIC PLAYS OF KNIGHTS AND ROUND TABLES.

bubbles.speaker: clerval
bubbles.text: TO THE ROUND TABLE!

panels.scene: the bespectacled boy staring up at a starry sky, yearning, tiny beneath the vast heavens

teen.narration: VICTOR CARES NOTHING FOR LANGUAGES OR POLITICS — ONLY THE DEEPEST SECRETS.

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: It was the secrets of heaven and earth that I desired to learn; and whether it was the outward substance of things or the inner spirit of nature and the mysterious soul of man that occupied me

panels.scene: the fair braided girl glowing warmly in a cosy lamplit home, a gentle calming presence

teen.narration: ELIZABETH IS THE GENTLE LIGHT THAT SOFTENS THEM BOTH.

bubbles.text: The saintly soul of Elizabeth shone like a shrine-dedicated lamp in our peaceful home.

panels.scene: a shadowy foreboding image of a small mountain stream swelling into a destroying torrent, sweeping away tiny happy figures

teen.narration: YET VICTOR LOOKS BACK AND SEES WHERE IT ALL BEGAN — A SMALL SOURCE THAT WOULD BECOME A FLOOD.

bubbles.text: when I would account to myself for the birth of that passion which afterwards ruled my destiny I find it arise, like a mountain river, from ignoble and almost forgotten sources; but, swelling as it proceeded, it became the torrent which, in its course, has swept away all my hopes and joys.

panels.scene: a rainy inn room; the bespectacled boy, age thirteen, pulling a dusty old volume from a shelf, transfixed

teen.narration: AT THIRTEEN, TRAPPED BY RAIN AT AN INN, HE FINDS AN OLD BOOK OF MAGIC AND ALCHEMY.

bubbles.text: In this house I chanced to find a volume of the works of Cornelius Agrippa.

panels.scene: the boy's face lit with dawning wonder, glowing pages open before him, ideas sparking around his head

teen.narration: IT LIGHTS A FIRE IN HIM.

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: A new light seemed to dawn upon my mind, and bounding with joy, I communicated my discovery to my father.

panels.scene: the slender bearded father glancing dismissively at the boy's old book, waving it off

teen.narration: BUT HIS FATHER WAVES IT AWAY WITH ONE CARELESS LINE — NEVER EXPLAINING WHY.

bubbles.speaker: alphonse
bubbles.text: Ah! Cornelius Agrippa! My dear Victor, do not waste your time upon this; it is sad trash.

panels.scene: the boy secretly surrounded by towering old alchemy books, dreaming of gold and eternal life

teen.narration: SO HE READS ON IN SECRET — CHASING THE ELIXIR OF LIFE ITSELF.

bubbles.text: the search of the philosopher's stone and the elixir of life

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: WHAT GLORY, TO BANISH DEATH!
what glory would attend the discovery if I could banish disease from the human frame and render man invulnerable to any but a violent death

panels.scene: a violent night thunderstorm; a bolt of lightning splitting a great old oak tree into ribbons before the house

teen.narration: THEN, AT FIFTEEN, A STORM SHOWS HIM A GREATER POWER.

bubbles.text: I beheld a stream of fire issue from an old and beautiful oak... nothing remained but a blasted stump.

panels.scene: a learned visitor gesturing at a charged apparatus, explaining electricity to the fascinated bespectacled boy

teen.narration: A LEARNED GUEST EXPLAINS ELECTRICITY AND GALVANISM — AND ALCHEMY SUDDENLY SEEMS WORTHLESS.

bubbles.speaker: victor
bubbles.text: ALL THAT HAD ENGAGED ME GREW DESPICABLE.
All that he said threw greatly into the shade Cornelius Agrippa, Albertus Magnus, and Paracelsus, the lords of my imagination

panels.scene: the bespectacled boy turning calmly to mathematics, while a dark storm looms unseen in the stars above him
panels.composition: wide, false calm with looming dread

teen.narration: HE TURNS TO SAFE MATHEMATICS — A BRIEF ESCAPE. BUT FATE HAS ALREADY DECIDED.

bubbles.text: Destiny was too potent, and her immutable laws had decreed my utter and terrible destruction.
